limits: This CPU analysis consumes actual GPUvaryings that were separately read back by root. It creates no GLprogram and does not modify shader/oracle/thresholds.
Matching actual interpolants validates arithmetic at those inputs, not that raster-interpolated offsets equal the requested physical source-centre coordinates.
SUBPIXEL_BITS was actually reported as4; the preceding8bit offline grid model is only an explanatory best fit, not a queried hardwarefact.
A projected-centre/gl_FragCoord runtime fix still requires actual original-golden rerun, legacy/head exact regressions, main/mirror/viewport checks and current source bounds.
